quick_skim.title: Gen Through the Lens: Camera-Controllable Video Generation via Cross-Coordinate Conditioning Fusion
quick_skim.abstract: We present Gen Through the Lens, a camera-controllable image-to-video generation framework that synthesizes videos from a given reference image while enabling realistic and physically consistent camera operations. Unlike previous models that treat camera motion as abstract conditioning or rely on a single coordinate system, our approach explicitly decomposes and fuses control signals across three coordinate spaces: the camera coordinate (modeled by intrinsic parameters), the world coordinate (represented by spatial geometry hints), and the object coordinate (described by 3D bounding boxes of target subjects). Through cross-coordinate conditioning fusion, these heterogeneous cues are unified to guide the generative process, enabling precise control of camera motion, focus, and framing while preserving temporal and spatial coherence. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method produces controllable and visually consistent results across diverse camera operations, outperforming existing approaches in both realism and editability.

quick_skim.llm_tldr_en: Gen Through the Lens is a camera-controllable image-to-video framework that decomposes and fuses control signals across camera, world, and object coordinate spaces for physically consistent camera motion.
quick_skim.llm_tldr_cn: 以往相机可控视频生成把相机运动当作抽象条件或仅依赖单一坐标系，难以保证物理一致的相机操作。本文提出Gen Through the Lens，将控制信号分解到相机坐标、世界坐标和物体坐标三个空间，并通过跨坐标条件融合统一异质线索来引导生成。该框架从参考图像合成具有真实相机运动的视频，为可控视频生成中的空间表示与几何一致性提供了明确的方法贡献。
